# domestic-ui

> domestic-ui is a CSS design system built on native HTML, custom properties and cascade layers. Link one stylesheet and semantic HTML is styled in light and dark, with WCAG 2.2 AA as the baseline. Theme it by overriding semantic tokens. It packages existing web standards and patterns; nothing here is original.

Link `css/domestic.css` (copy `css/` from https://github.com/odonckers/domestic-ui); semantic HTML needs no classes. Components: one `data-<component>` attribute of space-separated words matched with `~=` (`data-button="primary small"`), no classes; state via native attributes and ARIA. Layout primitives and utilities: `data-action-bar`, `.cluster`, `.grid`, `data-scroll`, `.stack`, `.visually-hidden`. Theme only with semantic `--dui-*` tokens; primitives are internal.

## Getting started

- [Getting started](https://odonckers.github.io/domestic-ui/index.md): domestic-ui is a CSS design system built on native HTML, custom properties and cascade layers.

## Principles

- [Principles](https://odonckers.github.io/domestic-ui/principles/index.md): domestic-ui packages existing web standards and well-known patterns.
- [Native element first](https://odonckers.github.io/domestic-ui/principles/native-element-first.md): Use the HTML element that already has the semantics and behavior you need: <button>, <a href>, <dialog>, <details>, <label>, <fieldset>, <table>.
- [Agent-friendly by design](https://odonckers.github.io/domestic-ui/principles/agent-friendly-by-design.md): Humans and coding agents should be able to write a whole view from this document alone.
- [Accessibility baseline: WCAG 2.2 AA](https://odonckers.github.io/domestic-ui/principles/accessibility-baseline-wcag-22-aa.md): Every example must pass, and every token pair is tested against, these criteria.
- [Cascade layers](https://odonckers.github.io/domestic-ui/principles/cascade-layers.md): css/domestic.css declares the order once, before anything else (@layer on MDN, CSS Cascade 5).
- [Theming](https://odonckers.github.io/domestic-ui/principles/theming.md): All tokens are custom properties on :root with the --dui- prefix.
- [Motion](https://odonckers.github.io/domestic-ui/principles/motion.md): Motion is CSS-first, token-driven and close to platform behavior: short fades, a drawer that slides from its edge, popovers and menus that grow a little as they appear, and color changes on buttons, links and the switch.
- [Elevation](https://odonckers.github.io/domestic-ui/principles/elevation.md): Elevation says which layer is on top.
- [Opinions we hold](https://odonckers.github.io/domestic-ui/principles/opinions-we-hold.md): Each of these is a choice between valid options, not a standard.
- [Layout primitives](https://odonckers.github.io/domestic-ui/principles/layout-primitives.md): Class: .stack, .cluster, .grid, [data-scroll="inline"], [data-scroll="block inline"].
- [Web components](https://odonckers.github.io/domestic-ui/principles/web-components.md): HTML still has no element for tabs, menus, roving focus in a toolbar, hover tooltips or a toast stack.
- [Explainers](https://odonckers.github.io/domestic-ui/principles/explainers.md): A pattern with no native element and no APG pattern is written up like a platform proposal in explainers/: problem, use cases, goals and non-goals, markup and API, keyboard, accessibility mappings, alternatives, prior art and open questions, with normative text in RFC 2119 keywords.
- [Tooling](https://odonckers.github.io/domestic-ui/principles/tooling.md): npm test runs, in order, and fails if any step fails.
- [Edges and alignment](https://odonckers.github.io/domestic-ui/principles/edges-and-alignment.md): Our choice: every container has a few named vertical lines, written in tokens, and every item sits on one of them or has a written reason, because edges picked by eye drift by a few pixels per panel and nobody can say which was meant.

## Tokens

- [Tokens](https://odonckers.github.io/domestic-ui/tokens/index.md): The two tiers of domestic-ui design tokens: 245 custom properties with their light and dark values.
- [Primitive tokens](https://odonckers.github.io/domestic-ui/tokens/primitives.md): All 109 primitive tokens in css/tokens/primitives.css (internal), with resolved light and dark values.
- [Semantic tokens](https://odonckers.github.io/domestic-ui/tokens/semantic.md): All 136 semantic tokens in css/tokens/semantic.css (public theming API), with resolved light and dark values.
- [Compact density](https://odonckers.github.io/domestic-ui/patterns/density.md): Available. A compact density token that tightens spacing for data-heavy screens. **Our choice:** No standard exists: `data-density="compact"` on any ancestor re-derives the density tokens; text size never changes and targets stay at least 24 by 24 CSS pixels.

## Base

- [Base elements](https://odonckers.github.io/domestic-ui/components/base.md): Native HTML elements styled by the base layer, with no classes.
- [Visually hidden](https://odonckers.github.io/domestic-ui/components/utilities/visually-hidden.md): Hides content visually but keeps it in the accessibility tree.

## Layout

- [Layouts](https://odonckers.github.io/domestic-ui/layouts/index.md): Layout primitives and planned page layouts of domestic-ui.
- [Action bar](https://odonckers.github.io/domestic-ui/layouts/action-bar.md): A long form whose Save and Cancel buttons stay in a sticky bar at the bottom of the window, with scroll margins so the bar never hides the focused field (WCAG 2.4.11).
- [Cluster](https://odonckers.github.io/domestic-ui/layouts/cluster.md): An inline group that wraps onto new lines (buttons, tags, nav links).
- [Grid](https://odonckers.github.io/domestic-ui/layouts/grid.md): A responsive grid: as many columns as fit, each at least --grid-min wide, never wider than the container.
- [Scroll](https://odonckers.github.io/domestic-ui/layouts/scroll.md): A scroll container for content wider than the screen, such as a data table, so it scrolls on its own instead of widening the page.
- [Stack](https://odonckers.github.io/domestic-ui/layouts/stack.md): Vertical flow with a consistent gap between children.
- [App shell](https://odonckers.github.io/domestic-ui/patterns/app-shell.md): Available. The frame of an application: header, primary sidebar, main content and an optional auxiliary sidebar. **Our choice:** No standard defines an app shell: the landmarks `<header>`, `<nav>`, `<main>` and `<aside>`, placed with CSS grid.
- [Dashboard](https://odonckers.github.io/domestic-ui/patterns/dashboard.md): Available. A grid of summary sections, each with a heading, that reflows to fit the screen. **Our choice:** No standard exists: a CSS grid of headed `<section>` elements that reflows without media queries.
- [List-detail](https://odonckers.github.io/domestic-ui/patterns/list-detail.md): Available. A list of items beside the details of the selected one, stacked on narrow screens. **Our choice:** No standard exists: real links beside a detail region, placed with CSS grid, so history and URLs keep working.
- [Split](https://odonckers.github.io/domestic-ui/patterns/split.md): Available. Two regions side by side at a set ratio, stacked on narrow screens. **Our choice:** No standard exists for a fixed split: two regions in a CSS grid. A draggable divider would follow the APG Window Splitter pattern.

## Atoms

- [Atoms](https://odonckers.github.io/domestic-ui/atoms/index.md): Every atom in domestic-ui.
- [Text helpers](https://odonckers.github.io/domestic-ui/components/atoms/text.md): Lead, small and muted text helpers from domestic-ui, with copyable markup.
- [Quiet link](https://odonckers.github.io/domestic-ui/components/atoms/link.md): A link that takes the surrounding text color and keeps its underline, for dense UI.
- [Buttons](https://odonckers.github.io/domestic-ui/components/atoms/button.md): Button variants and sizes, links styled as buttons, and disabled and loading states.
- [Form controls](https://odonckers.github.io/domestic-ui/components/atoms/controls.md): Native form controls as styled by the domestic-ui base layer, with copyable markup.
- [Switch](https://odonckers.github.io/domestic-ui/components/atoms/switch.md): An on/off switch built on a native checkbox with role switch, following the APG Switch pattern.
- [Field](https://odonckers.github.io/domestic-ui/components/atoms/field.md): Label, control, hint and error message wired with aria-describedby and aria-invalid.
- [Badge](https://odonckers.github.io/domestic-ui/components/atoms/badge.md): Inline status labels with tone variants that meet WCAG AA contrast.
- [Icon](https://odonckers.github.io/domestic-ui/components/atoms/icon.md): Inline Lucide SVG icons sized by a token, icon and label buttons, and icon-only buttons with a name and a tooltip.

## Molecules

- [Molecules](https://odonckers.github.io/domestic-ui/molecules/index.md): Every molecule in domestic-ui, with the patterns planned at this level.
- [Alerts](https://odonckers.github.io/domestic-ui/patterns/alerts.md): Available. Status messages, from notices in the page to live alerts and toasts. Follows [APG Alert pattern](https://www.w3.org/WAI/ARIA/apg/patterns/alert/).
- [Breadcrumb](https://odonckers.github.io/domestic-ui/patterns/breadcrumb.md): Available. The path to the current page: an ordered list of links in a labelled `<nav>`. Follows [APG Breadcrumb pattern](https://www.w3.org/WAI/ARIA/apg/patterns/breadcrumb/).
- [Card](https://odonckers.github.io/domestic-ui/patterns/card.md): Available. A self-contained item, such as an article teaser, on a raised surface. **Our choice:** No standard exists: an `<article>` whose heading holds the one link, so the link name stays short.
- [Disclosure](https://odonckers.github.io/domestic-ui/patterns/disclosure.md): Available. A summary that shows or hides more content, built on `<details>` and `<summary>`. Follows [HTML `<details>` element](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/multipage/interactive-elements.html#the-details-element), [APG Disclosure pattern](https://www.w3.org/WAI/ARIA/apg/patterns/disclosure/).
- [Menu button](https://odonckers.github.io/domestic-ui/patterns/menu-button.md): Available. A button that opens a menu of actions. Follows [APG Menu Button pattern](https://www.w3.org/WAI/ARIA/apg/patterns/menu-button/).
- [Pagination](https://odonckers.github.io/domestic-ui/patterns/pagination.md): Available. Links to the pages of a long list of results. **Our choice:** No standard exists: a labelled `<nav>` with a list of links and `aria-current="page"`, as for breadcrumbs.
- [Popover](https://odonckers.github.io/domestic-ui/patterns/popover.md): Available. Content shown on top of the page from a button, with the `popover` attribute. Follows [HTML `popover` attribute](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/multipage/popover.html#the-popover-attribute), [MDN Popover API](https://developer.mozilla.org/en-US/docs/Web/API/Popover_API).
- [Search](https://odonckers.github.io/domestic-ui/patterns/search.md): Available. A search form in a `<search>` landmark with an `<input type="search">`. Follows [HTML `<search>` element](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/multipage/grouping-content.html#the-search-element), [MDN `<input type="search">`](https://developer.mozilla.org/en-US/docs/Web/HTML/Reference/Elements/input/search).
- [Tabs](https://odonckers.github.io/domestic-ui/patterns/tabs.md): Available. Sections of content shown one at a time, chosen from a list of tabs. Follows [APG Tabs pattern](https://www.w3.org/WAI/ARIA/apg/patterns/tabs/).
- [Toolbar](https://odonckers.github.io/domestic-ui/patterns/toolbar.md): Available. A row of related controls that is one stop in the tab order. Follows [APG Toolbar pattern](https://www.w3.org/WAI/ARIA/apg/patterns/toolbar/).
- [Typeahead](https://odonckers.github.io/domestic-ui/patterns/typeahead.md): Available. A text field that suggests values as you type: `<datalist>` first, an APG combobox where it falls short. Follows [HTML `<datalist>` element](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/multipage/form-elements.html#the-datalist-element), [APG Combobox pattern](https://www.w3.org/WAI/ARIA/apg/patterns/combobox/).

## Organisms

- [Organisms](https://odonckers.github.io/domestic-ui/organisms/index.md): Every organism in domestic-ui, with the patterns planned at this level.
- [Page header](https://odonckers.github.io/domestic-ui/components/organisms/page-header.md): The top of a screen: an optional breadcrumb, the title, a description and actions that sit beside the title when there is room and wrap under it when not.
- [Dialog and drawer](https://odonckers.github.io/domestic-ui/patterns/dialog.md): Available. A modal `<dialog>`, either centered or as a drawer along one edge of the viewport. Follows [HTML `<dialog>` element](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/multipage/interactive-elements.html#the-dialog-element), [APG Dialog (Modal) pattern](https://www.w3.org/WAI/ARIA/apg/patterns/dialog-modal/).
- [Site navigation](https://odonckers.github.io/domestic-ui/patterns/nav.md): Available. The main links of a site in a `<nav>` landmark, with the current page marked. Follows [HTML `<nav>` element](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/multipage/sections.html#the-nav-element), [APG Landmark regions](https://www.w3.org/WAI/ARIA/apg/practices/landmark-regions/), [APG Disclosure navigation example](https://www.w3.org/WAI/ARIA/apg/patterns/disclosure/examples/disclosure-navigation/).
- [Data table](https://odonckers.github.io/domestic-ui/patterns/data-table.md): Available. Rows of records in a native `<table>` with a caption, header cells and optional sorting. Follows [HTML `<table>` element](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/multipage/tables.html#the-table-element), [APG Table pattern](https://www.w3.org/WAI/ARIA/apg/patterns/table/).
- [Filter bar](https://odonckers.github.io/domestic-ui/patterns/filter-bar.md): Available. A row of native form controls that narrows a list or table. **Our choice:** No standard exists: a `<form>` in `<search>` with labelled controls, and the result count as a status message.
- [Large forms](https://odonckers.github.io/domestic-ui/patterns/large-forms.md): Available. Long forms split into labelled groups, in one or more columns. Follows [HTML `<form>` element](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/multipage/forms.html#the-form-element), [HTML `<fieldset>` element](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/multipage/form-elements.html#the-fieldset-element).

## Patterns

- [Patterns](https://odonckers.github.io/domestic-ui/patterns/index.md): Planned and available interface patterns, from site navigation to app shells, with the standard each one follows.

## Demos

- [Demos](https://odonckers.github.io/domestic-ui/demos.md): Demo apps in demos/ that use domestic-ui, each with a link to its source on GitHub.
- [Accessibility checker](https://github.com/odonckers/domestic-ui/tree/main/demos/a11y): Checks the built demo apps the same way the repository checks `examples/`: Playwright with [axe](https://github.com/dequelabs/axe-core) (tags `wcag2a`, `wcag2aa`, `wcag21a`, `wcag21aa`, `wcag22aa`), in light and dark, with every `<details>` opened and checked again.
- [Angular](https://github.com/odonckers/domestic-ui/tree/main/demos/angular): The dashboard, account settings and orders views in Angular 22: standalone components, three routes (`''`, `'settings'` and `'orders'`) with Angular Router, a `title` per route, and `routerLinkActive` with `ariaCurrentWhenActive="page"` for the current link.
- [Astro](https://github.com/odonckers/domestic-ui/tree/main/demos/astro): The dashboard, account settings and orders views as three static Astro pages (`src/pages/index.astro`, `src/pages/settings.astro` and `src/pages/orders.astro`) sharing `src/layouts/Base.astro`.
- [React](https://github.com/odonckers/domestic-ui/tree/main/demos/react): The dashboard, account settings and orders views in React 19 with Vite, as a three-page [multi-page app](https://vite.dev/guide/build#multi-page-app) (`index.html`, `settings.html` and `orders.html`).
- [Plain HTML](https://github.com/odonckers/domestic-ui/tree/main/demos/vanilla): The dashboard, account settings and orders views as three static HTML files, with no build step.
- [Views](https://odonckers.github.io/domestic-ui/demos.md): Dashboard, Account settings and Orders, with each app's source file.
